Hi Lena — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope, stakeholders and the runway to decision.

Pain & objective (as we heard it)
- Inaccurate triage across claims data causing ~20% manual review overhead.
- Need sub-200ms tail latency for real-time triage at peak volumes.
- High sensitivity around PHI and auditability for downstream compliance.

Success metrics you shared
- Reduce manual triage by 40% on day 90
- 99.9% availability for production traffic, 99th pct latency <300ms
- Evidence for audit: request-level logging + retention policy (7 years)

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MPA) — first-pass (attached: Sunrise_MPA-draft-v1.pdf)
1) Pilot kickoff & data sampling (owner: Sunrise data team) — target: Nov 22–Dec 3
2) Model selection & quantization recommendation (owner: Redwood SE) — target: Dec 6
3) Security & compliance review (SOC2 evidence, KMS/HSM integration) — target: Dec 10 (prep)
4) Pilot validation & metrics review (joint) — target: Jan 7
5) Decision / procurement window — target: Jan 14–21

Immediate asks from your side
- Confirm primary approver for procurement and legal (name + email).
- Share a representative sample (de-identified) of triage logs by Nov 20.

What we’ll deliver this week
- Draft MPA (attached) with milestone owners and dates
- A short sizing matrix for pilot infra needs
- A 30-minute deep-dive with our SE (Ben) to validate latency and data-flow assumptions

Would you be able to confirm stakeholders and your preferred pilot start date by Friday (Nov 14)? If yes, I’ll lock in Ben for a deep-dive call next week.

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Monica / Rishi — thanks for the context and the recording. Quick technical notes and commitments below (will feed into updated MPA and the short SOC2 evidence packet).

1) Continuous batching & latency
- We can tune continuous batching with a max-latency cap to hit ~250–280ms 99th for the small model family (7–13B) on T4x2-equivalent during the pilot. If Sunrise wants sub-200ms tail we should plan for at least one A100 node for critical routes.

2) Quantization tradeoffs
- FP16: best accuracy, higher cost.
- INT8: ~5–7% delta on recall for their triage classifier in our prior benchmarks; huge cost savings. Recommend A/B run for two weeks of pilot to measure real-world delta.

3) Pilot infra sizing (see attached pilot-sizing-matrix.xlsx)
- Baseline (200 req/s burst): 3x T4-equivalent workers + 1 hot A100 for tail-sensitive traffic
- Expected cloud egress and logging: estimate 120GB/day during peak validation

4) SOC2 & security artifacts
- I’ll bundle a trimmed SOC2 evidence packet (control descriptions + SOC2 report link) and a short note on KMS integration (we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and HSM-backed key storage options).

5) Commitments and next steps
- Ben to lead SE deep-dive on Nov 16 or Nov 17 (I’m available Nov 16 11:00–12:30 PT and Nov 17 14:00–15:00 PT)
- I’ll update the MPA with the infra and quantization options by Nov 18 EOD and send to Monica for review.
